question: Prior to performing an organ transplant, the serological status (presence of antibodies) of both the donor and the possible recipient is systematically determined against certain microorganisms, including cytomegalovirus (CMV). In which of the following situations does the highest incidence of CMV disease occur in recipients of a solid organ transplant?

options.opa: When both the donor and the recipient of the organ have positive serology against CMV.
options.opb: When the donor has negative serology against CMV and the positive receptor.
options.opc: When both the donor and the recipient of the organ have negative serology against CMV.
options.opd: When the donor has positive serology against CMV and the negative receptor.
